limits: Laravel Cloud is the confirmed target. The actual repository/branch, Cloud environment and database/bucket configuration are still needed. No Cloud build, staging deployment, real administrator or production rollout has occurred.

The read-only Cloud diagnostic honestly reports blockers: application key/HTTPS, hosted web gate, target database/PDO MySQL, secure sessions, durable private evidence and missing S3 adapter in this local configuration. It is not a deployment or proof of actual infrastructure.

Actual MySQL/MariaDB, shared cache/scheduler, bucket permissions/read/write/redeploy/backup, real onboarding and browser/mobile/keyboard acceptance remain unverified. Installed vendor/Composer files are unchanged; adding the S3 adapter and lock must be integrated in the actual repository.

Only sourced Active programme status and independently checked actual meeting dates produce reminders. Unknown history/status/owners are checks; paused/completed/withdrawn/transferred programmes do not receive automatic review prompts. This does not remove follow-up/support or historical evidence duties.

Marking seen only acknowledges a source. A checked meeting + 70-day reference remains until changed by another checked actual meeting or source withdrawal. One reminder per source/recipient, no daily escalation/email cadence is implemented.

Manual external signing checks do not provide electronic signing, cryptographic validation, participant authentication, employer portal sharing or full historical compliance. Fixtures are fictional and do not establish signature authenticity.

No real data, external messages or scheduler activation. The combined in-portal schedule now includes marking/Careers/reviews, stays opt-in and off by default. Existing enabled deployments need to review its extended scope.
Formal curriculum/KSB/Foundation/S9/gateway/source reconciliation, financial/funding decisions and broader approved KPI policy remain separate.
